history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration establish joint steering committee in relevant countries in accordance with the requirements of the terms of reference for the Peacebuilding Fund.
history.administration_response: Due to in-country political processes, neither El Salvador nor Honduras, the remaining two countries, has established its joint steering committee. Given that joint steering committees are meant to be nationally owned, the Fund is not in a position to force the establishment of these mechanisms if the country situation is not conducive thereto. Noting the difficult political situations in which the Fund operates, and recognizing that there is more than 90 per cent compliance in establishing joint steering committee in other eligible countries, it is requested that this recommendation be closed.
history.board_assessment: Given that there is more than 90 per cent compliance in establishing joint steering committee in eligible countries and that the Fund is not in a position to force the establishment of these mechanisms if the country situation is not conducive thereto, the Board considers this recommendation implemented.
